naming.alias_policy: BenchCore is retained only when quoting an old runner label; this experiment and current system are named BenchAudit.

reference.warning: The rubric reference is a prior two-stage LLM evidence review, not exhaustive human gold. Rubric P/R/F1 are conditional on the explicitly reviewed positive/negative subset. The output reference supplies known positives from a deterministic scan, not exhaustive human clean labels; output precision/F1 are strict reference-alignment metrics.

metric_policy.attempted_full388: Operational unknowns are treated as not detected. This is an intention-to-audit conservative convention, not a clean model-only estimate.
metric_policy.evaluable_subset: Exclude rubric rows whose scanner or verifier had an operational failure; report coverage beside P/R/F1.

llm.observed_token_stop_semantics: soft stop after provider-reported usage; not a concurrent hard cap
